name: design-review
summary: Score a design on six weighted dimensions and return prioritised findings, each with the fix.

when: a design needs judging before it ships
an existing product needs a consistency audit
not: deciding whether something is any GOOD, as taste

steps: Score Visual Hierarchy, Consistency, Accessibility, Usability (20% each), Responsiveness and Performance (10% each). Compute the weighted total.
Run the accessibility lens properly; use contrast.py for any pair you are unsure of rather than estimating.
Check the anti-slop tells. A passing gate is never evidence of taste.
Apply the ten usability heuristics and flag violations by number.
Rank findings Critical, Major, Minor, Enhancement. Every finding names a specific fix, not a direction.
output: The six-dimension scored table, then a findings table: number, severity, finding, recommendation.
done: every score is justified by a named observation
every finding has a specific fix
any number quoted came from a gate that was actually run
